descriptions.preferred: Spring leaves are a brilliant scarlet or crimson-scarlet which lasts a month or more before becoming a pleasant reddish green, then turning red and orange in the fall. The small leaves are moderately deeply divided into five to seven strongly ovate lobes with pointed tips. The margins have sharp teeth. The slender leafstalks and young shoots are redbrown to dark purple-red. This cultivar forms a shrub up to 10 ft. (3 m) high and 61⁄2 ft. (2 m) wide. It is an excellent container plant for patio display and is popular as a bonsai plant. Shin means "new," implying that the plant is an improved selection of the well-known

rhs.description: A compact, bushy shrub with lobed leaves that open red, becoming green speckled with white in summer, and turning reddish-orange in autumn

attributes.suggested_uses: Low Maintenance, City/Courtyard Gardens, Cottage/Informal Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。
attributes.suggested_uses: 低维护、城市庭院、乡村/自然式花园

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 紧凑、丛生的灌木。裂叶初展时为红色，夏季转为绿色并带白色斑点，秋季变为带红调的橙色。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 春叶呈鲜艳的猩红色或深绯红色，可持续一个月以上，之后转为悦目的带红绿色，秋季再转为红色和橙色。叶片较小，中度至较深裂，通常为 5-7 裂，裂片明显卵形，先端尖锐。叶缘具锐齿。细长叶柄和幼枝呈红褐色至深紫红色。该品种形成灌木状株形，高可达 10 英尺（3 米），宽约 6 1/2 英尺（2 米）。非常适合作为庭院容器观赏植物，也很受欢迎用于盆景。Shin 意为“新”，暗示该品种是著名 'Desho¯jo¯' 的改良选拔品种。
